verses.text: "Run for safety, people of Benjamin! Get out of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise a signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster is coming from the north, a terrible destruction.
I will destroy the daughter of Zion, so beautiful and delicate.
Shepherds with their flocks will come against her. They will set up their tents all around her, each one grazing in his own spot."
"Get ready to fight against her! Get up, let us attack at noon! But how terrible for us, the day is ending, and the evening shadows are growing long.
So get up, let us attack at night and destroy her strong towers!"
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Cut down the trees and build a ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished. It is full of cruelty.
As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps pouring out her wickedness. Violence and destruction echo in her streets. I always see her sickness and her wounds.
Listen to this warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you in disgust and make your land a wasteland where no one can live."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Let them pick clean the survivors of Israel, as one picks the last grapes from a vine. Pass your hand over the branches again, like someone gathering grapes."
Who can I speak to and warn? Who will listen to me? Look, their ears are closed, so they cannot hear. Look, the word of the LORD is a joke to them. They find no pleasure in it.

But I am full of the anger of the LORD, and I am tired of holding it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the young men gathered together. Husbands and wives will be taken, and the old and those who are very old.
Their houses will be given to others, along with their fields and their wives. For I will raise my hand against those who live in the land," says the LORD.
"From the least to the greatest, all of them are greedy for money. From prophets to priests, they all lie and cheat.
They treat the wounds of my people as if they were not serious. They say, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace.

Are they ashamed of their disgusting actions? No, they have no shame at all. They do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among those who fall. When I punish them, they will be brought down," says the LORD.

This is what the LORD says: "Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it. Then you will find rest for your souls. But you said, 'We will not walk in it.'
I put watchmen over you and said, 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!' But you said, 'We will not listen.'
So listen, you nations! Pay attention, you witnesses, to what will happen to them.
Listen, earth! I am bringing disaster on this people, the result of their own plans. For they have not listened to my words, and they have rejected my teaching.
What good to me is incense from Sheba or sweet smelling cane from a faraway land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable. Your sacrifices do not please me."
So this is what the LORD says: "I will put obstacles in front of this people. Fathers and sons alike will trip over them. Neighbors and friends will die."
This is what the LORD says: "Look, an army is coming from the land of the north. A great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.
They carry bows and spears. They are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses. They come lined up for battle to attack you, daughter of Zion."
We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp with fear. Pain has gripped us, pain like a woman giving birth.
Do not go out into the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.
My people, put on sackcloth and roll in the ashes. Mourn with bitter crying as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
"I have made you a tester of my people, like someone who tests metals, so that you can watch and test their ways.
They are all stubborn rebels who go around spreading lies. They are like bronze and iron. They are all corrupt.
The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining is useless. The wicked are not removed.
They will be called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them."
